run_training_iterations: run training or validation iterations for a graph neural network model using DGL batched inputs
validate_model: validate a model on a test split and compute MAP@R metric tracking best epoch
compute_pairwise_similarity: compute pairwise cosine similarity between code vectors and separate positive and negative pairs
calculate_map_at_r: calculate the mean average precision at R metric from a similarity matrix and program IDs
compute_retrieval_metrics: compute MAP@R, average precision, and AUPRG retrieval metrics from similarity scores and labels
